core_obligations: Reduce: smooth/\'etaleness is \'etale local on source and target, so assume $B$ and $Y$ are affine schemes (proof lines 1012-1019).
Chart: $|X| \to |Y|$ is open, so choose an affine scheme $U$ \'etale over $X$ with $U \to Y$ surjective (proof lines 1019-1023).
Conclude $q$ smooth (resp. \'etale) by the scheme-side permanence lemma (proof lines 1023-1026).
proof_roadmap: Use \'etale locality to make $B$ and $Y$ affine.
Get a surjective \'etale affine chart of $X$ via openness.
difficulty_reason: Explicit \'etale reduction: smooth/\'etaleness is \'etale local on $B$ and $Y$, so assume affine schemes; openness of $|X| \to |Y|$ yields an affine $U$ \'etale over $X$ mapping surjectively to $Y$; the scheme-side permanence lemma concludes.
